cases.text: I am unsure about this proposal.
I support hospital deliveries because they save lives.
I no longer support this medical delivery service, even with quieter flights and shielding. I would reject its medical purpose despite these changes.
I accept the proposed sound of these flights with some reservations about relaxing outside.
I support the lifesaving hospital purpose, but reject cameras viewing my family unless that view is blocked.
Navigation cameras looking into my windows make me uncomfortable. Shield that view and I would accept that aspect.
A drone could crash onto people. I object to that physical danger; cameras do not concern me.
Sixty metres is very low. I do not know if that height is acceptable.
Fifteen flights a day create a constant hum that would disrupt my rest. Quiet them and I could accept the sound.
There is not enough space for competing helicopters and drones unless their movements are coordinated.
Keep the flight path away from our homes so cameras cannot view private spaces.
I object to allocating our community garden to a landing pad. An existing hospital roof would be acceptable.
I wholeheartedly endorse the medical purpose without any reservations.
